g.title: note
g.text: Amber = human decision. Reject or unresolved checks = stop; nothing published.
Evaluator owns the private dataset, gold and outcome judgments; submitted questions stay in isolated run state.
No shared-memory learning or publication from final cases. Tool hooks and scrubbed traces cover every step.
